snippet.title: RuneQuest: Warlords | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
We’re thrilled to announce that RuneQuest: Warlords will release on December 9.
Lead legendary heroes, command powerful armies, and harness the might of the Runes in a turn-based strategy game set in the mythic world of Glorantha.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://nwzo.io/click/c26ea 
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️  https://discord.gg/Xb5ap82qT4 
🦎 More info on Slitherine ➡️ https://www.slitherine.com/game/runequest-warlords
